technology_name: Super Absorbent Polymer from Cassava Starch
institution: ICAR-Central Tuber Crops Research Institute (CTCRI) Thiruvananthapuram
problem_solved: Low soil water retention during drought and moisture-stress conditions.
description: Semi-synthetic super absorbent polymer (SAP) prepared from cassava starch.The addition of hydrogel to the soil and irrigating field at an interval of once in three days could increase the porosity and water holding capacity of the soil while maintaining higher nutrient levels for better plant growth.The SAP is a useful soil additive during drought and other moisture-stress conditions
applications:
Soil moisture retention in agricultural fields
Drought management in rainfed farming systems
Water-efficient cultivation of horticultural crops
Soil conditioning and nutrient retention enhancement
Sustainable irrigation and water conservation programs
